thesis: Brent Beshore describes his firm's mission as cultivating a disaster-resistant compound interest machine by buying boring businesses in the lower end of the lower middle market and making them less boring. He explains that his firm targets companies with owner earnings between $1 and $10 million, paying reasonable prices to help leadership transition and improve profitability.
